text:
mira: Heads-up — PR #21002 is ready for final sign-off. Needs runtime + infra + security approvals before TOMORROW 10:00 PT merge window. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/21002

mira: tl;dr: changes to KV cache prefetch -> capped-prefetch behavior, eviction header toggle, small runtime proto change. Behavior change for long seqs, potential mem reduction.

mira: checklist I added in PR: 1) runtime review (behavior + perf), 2) infra review (eviction config + autoscaler impacts), 3) security SCA scan + proto schema review, 4) canary plan + rollback notes.

tony: @mira @jess I can own runtime review. quick question — have you got perf baselines for seq > 4096? last perf CI job had a spike. :thinking:

mira: added benchmark output to the PR description, see `bench/kv/capped-prefetch/2026-03-15.txt`. baseline shows ~18% lower mem in steady-state on our 80-token median workload; worst-case tail still needs checking.

jess: tagging infra: @infra-owners for visibility. I'll look at the eviction config diff. if autoscaler config changes are required we need to align with pool-sizing doc. can you paste the diff or config snippet here?

mira: pasted config snippet in PR and here:```yaml
eviction_header: enabled
eviction_thresholds:
  small: 0.65
  default: 0.8
  aggressive: 0.9
prefetch: capped
  cap_tokens: 1024
```

jess: looks reasonable. two asks: (1) add a canary route with 10% traffic and autoscaler min during canary to avoid unintended scale-downs, (2) run infra e2e in staging with large seq traffic. I can approve after those.

sam: security note: runtime proto bump requires a quick schema review and a dependency SCA run. please attach the `sbom.json` and SCA results. also confirm there is no new external call surface.

mira: SBOM attached in PR artifacts; ran `snyk` and `oss-scan`, results attached — two low-severity deps flagged but both transitive and within approved list. no new external endpoints.

deploy-bot: CI status — checks: unit ✅, integration ✅, perf-smoke ⚠️ (flaky on long-seq test), security-scan ✅, e2e-staging queued.

lee: I can stand up the canary and monitor logs during rollout tomorrow. please add me to the canary runbook in PR.

tony: I'll prioritize runtime review today and post comments by 17:00 PT. if perf-smoke stays flaky, suggest we either rerun or temporarily pin the flaky test in canary gating with a follow-up issue.

jess: re: autoscaler min during canary — set `min_replicas: 2` for the canary pool and `canary_percentage: 10`. once we see stable metrics after 30m we can scale to 100%.

sam: I'll sign off once e2e-staging completes and SCA low-severity triage is noted in PR. ping me after CI green.

mira: thanks everyone — I've updated PR with canary config and added lee to runbook. tagging reviewers: @tony @jess @sam — please add approvals in PR when ready. will plan merge at 10:00 PT tomorrow if all signs green. :+1:

tony: noted — taking ownership of runtime approval.

jess: will run infra e2e tonight, should be able to approve by morning.

sam: will re-run SCA after e2e and confirm.

mira: perfect — I'll follow up with a final pre-merge checklist message 1h before merge window.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: merge window TOMORROW 10:00 PT — scheduled notification 60 minutes prior.
